segments.arabic:
١٠٩٧٨- جعدة بنت عبيد
بن ثعلبة بن سواد بن غنم بن حارثة الأنصارية «٣» .
بايعت النبيّ ﷺ، قاله ابن حبيب، واستدركها ابن الأثير.
قلت: وقد ذكرها ابن سعد، فقال أمها الرعاة بنت عدي بن سواد، ثم تزوجها النعمان بن نفيع فولدت له حارثة الصحابي المشهور، ثم خلف عليها الحباب بن الأرقم، [فولدت] له الحارث، وأسلمت جعدة وبايعت.
segments.english:
10978—Ja'da bint Ubayd
ibn Tha'laba ibn Sawad ibn Ghanm ibn Haritha, the Ansari woman (3).
She pledged allegiance to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Ibn Habib stated this, and Ibn al-Athir supplied her as an omission.
I say: Ibn Sa'd also mentioned her, saying: Her mother was al-Ru'ah bint Adi ibn Sawad. She then married al-Nu'man ibn Nufay' and bore him Haritha, the well-known Companion. Thereafter, al-Hubab ibn al-Arqam succeeded him as her husband, and [she bore] him al-Harith. Ja'da embraced Islam and pledged allegiance.

unresolved.explanation: The unvocalized canonical spelling does not conclusively establish the initial short vowel of this personal name. The final text provisionally uses al-Ru'ah, the morphologically expected reading, but none of the supplied Urdu or collateral Arabic witnesses attests the name's vocalization directly.
